title: Same Behavior, Different Mechanism: What Finite Experiments Can Certify About Integrated Information
abstract: arXiv:2611.08469v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interpretability, AI auditing and assessments of machine consciousness increasingly rest on mechanism-level quantities: functionals of a system's causal transition law that describe how it computes, not what it outputs. Experiments see that law only through finite, partial and noisy interventions. We ask when such a quantity is identifiable from an experiment's access, continuous in the mechanism and certifiable from finite data, and answer exactly for a deliberately demanding case - the integrated information $\varphi$ of integrated information theory - in stochastic networks of four and five units with known ground truth. Behavior can be silent: a recurrent and a feed-forward network with identical input-output laws at their response delay carry 0.28 and 0 bits, yet internal recordings separate them within 4-53 trials. Partial access can be just as blind: in our examples, units left out of a one-step recording impose precision floors

translated_title: 相同行为，不同机制：有限实验能对整合信息认证什么
translated_abstract: 可解释性、AI 审计以及机器意识评估越来越依赖于机制层面的量：这些量是系统因果转移律的泛函，描述系统如何计算，而非它输出什么。实验只能通过有限的、部分的且有噪声的干预来观察这一规律。我们探究这样的量何时能从实验的访问权限中被识别、对机制连续、并能从有限数据中得到认证，并针对一个刻意苛刻的情形——整合信息理论中的整合信息 $\varphi$——在具有已知真实答案的四单元和五单元随机网络中给出了精确的回答。行为可能是沉默的：一个循环网络与一个前馈网络在其响应延迟处具有完全相同的输入输出规律，分别携带 0.28 和 0 比特，但内部记录在 4-53 次试验内即可将二者区分开来。部分访问可能同样盲目：在我们的例子中，单步记录中被排除的单元会造成精度下限
tldr: 本文在具有已知真实答案的小型随机网络中精确刻画了整合信息 φ 等机制级量何时可被识别、连续且可由有限数据认证，并证明输入输出行为完全相同的网络可携带截然不同的整合信息（0.28 比特 vs 0 比特），但只需 4-53 次内部记录试验即可将其区分。
en_tdlr: This paper precisely characterizes when mechanism-level quantities like integrated information φ are identifiable, continuous, and certifiable from finite data in small stochastic networks with known ground truth, showing that behaviorally identical networks can carry vastly different integrated information (0.28 vs 0 bits) yet be separated by just 4-53 internal recording trials.
